title: SQL Injection (login bypass)
impact: Allows unauthenticated attackers to bypass authentication and gain full administrator privileges without credentials, compromising all application data and administrative controls.
remediation: Implement parameterized queries or prepared statements for authentication, ensuring user inputs are strictly treated as data rather than executable SQL.

title: SQL Injection (data extraction via search)
payload_used: ')) UNION SELECT id, email, password, '4', '5', '6', '7', '8', '9' FROM Users--
impact: Enables unauthorized extraction of sensitive records from backend tables, including user emails, password hashes, and database schema information.
remediation: Use parameterized queries with bound parameters for product searches and implement strict input validation on search queries.

title: Reflected XSS
impact: Allows execution of arbitrary JavaScript in the victim's browser session, potentially enabling session cookie theft, credential harvesting, or redirection to malicious sites.
remediation: Apply context-aware output encoding to all user-supplied search parameters before rendering them in the DOM and implement a Content Security Policy (CSP).

title: Stored XSS
impact: Enables persistent execution of malicious scripts whenever users or administrators view stored feedback, risking administrative session hijacking and unauthorized state-changing actions.
remediation: Sanitize user-submitted HTML inputs using a trusted library such as DOMPurify before storage and apply HTML entity encoding upon rendering.
